name: manifest-lines-become-attachments
why: Attaching files writes them into the prompt as @path tokens. A line made up only of such tokens is an attachment manifest: it is not shown as text, and the files appear once, as attachments.
text:
@uploads/Stromlaufplan.pdf @uploads/Sicherungsuebersicht.xlsx

Ok, ich schicke dir mal die ganzen Elektrodaten.

expect.text: Ok, ich schicke dir mal die ganzen Elektrodaten.
